# R2.17 — Bench/measurement legs — resolver checks + DebtPolicy consumers

Ticket `docs/tickets/123_R2.17__bench-measurement-legs.md`
(seq 123). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.16` (PR #123);
ADR-0349. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the
recorded-corpus legs run over the committed `benchset/stage3_v1`
tree and the resolver legs run against `LabDocs`/records-in; the
*live* foreign-manifest import stays environment-gated under
R2.21 (HUMAN-H3) and is not faked.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.24-1 · DF-S1.24-2 (machine cells) ·
BL-26 · R-2.9.4 · R-2.9.8 · R-2.10.3 · AC-R-2.9.6-11/-12 · CC9.

## What landed

**Production resolver-backed `validate_removal_test` context checks
(DF-S1.24-1; ADR-0349 D1).** `hh_debt::schedule::instantiate_check`
runs the context-parameterized battery inside `schedule_removal_test`
and per-member inside `schedule_batch`, bound from production inputs:
`policy` + `declared_sinks` from the operative `DebtPolicy`
(`InsufficientRunway`, `OwnerUnreachable`), `resolve_template` from
the caller-resolved `ExperimentSpec`, `split_assigned` from the
resolved template's `suite.split_assignment_ref`, `artifact_sealed`
from every arm's `artifact_ref.version_id` under the one §5h.2 §2
pin spelling (`hh_ontology::eval::is_pinned_version_id`, now public —
CC1). A context miss is `Deferred{reason}` data — new spellings
`unexecutable:<reason>`, `insufficient_runway`, `owner_unreachable`,
`dead_weight_design_disallowed` — never a silent drop; a failing
batch member makes the batch `BatchIncompatible`. New
`hh_hir::debt::validate_removal_test_at` is the home-free entry
point (`SweepEntry.home` is caller-projected — the verdict never
degrades, only the refusal detail text).

**`lab.debt.sweep` resolves `template_ref` through `LabDocs`
(D4).** `resolve_entry_templates` fills `entries[].template` from
the production store when the caller does not project it —
`docs.spec(ref)` (the `lab.experiment.*` `put_spec` deposit) then
`docs.get_named(SPEC, ref)`; records-in stays authoritative (a
projected `template` wins), a store miss keeps
`template_unresolved`, a corrupt deposit is a schema violation,
never a fabricated spec.

**Every `DebtPolicy` member is now a runtime consumer (D2/D3).**
`grace_period_ms` — `ProfileChange.changed_at_ms` (additive;
`evaluate_debt` derives `changed_at_ms + grace_period_ms <= now_ms`,
OR-ed with the caller flag; `hh-embed`'s lifecycle seam stamps it).
`schedule` — non-empty at `register` + the `sweep.completed` durable
row's `cadence` attribution. `priority` — closed-set
(`PRIORITY_SPELLINGS`) at `register` and at the schedule point.
`dead_weight_designs_allowed` — gates the resolved template's
`PreRegistration.dead_weight_purpose` (new additive member — the
design-side datum ADR-0126's admissibility rule needs; default
`false`, emitted only when true).

**`task_id` round-trip stability + recorded-corpus legs
(DF-S1.24-2 machine cells; D5).** `crates/hh-bench/tests/r2_17.rs` ×6:
codec round-trip + `check_id` (the importer's compute-vs-trust
predicate — a forged id never verifies) + canonical-form stability
over the whole corpus; the imported-vs-annotated partition
(foreign identity, `validity`/`contamination`, provenance, `ext`
never move `task_id`); `SuiteManifest`/`SplitAssignmentRecord`
round-trips + the L1/L2 admission checks; the adapter `expose`
`task_id`-preservation leg.
